summary: Mica is a young Hearthian found next to the remote-control model ship they built with Slate's help in the Village. They challenge the player to land it on a geyser pool, serving as a tutorial for the spaceship's flight controls.

behavior: Mica is enthusiastic and impatient to see the protagonist's launch.
Mica is the only character with their name in a Steam Achievement.
location: Mica is found in the Village next to the remote-control model ship.
Mica is the second character the player encounters on the path up to fetch the launch codes.
lore: Mica built the model spaceship with Slate's help.
Mica and Slate recently recalibrated the model's controls and installed better thrusters.
Slate said the model is just like the real ship, only less likely to start a fire.
Mayor Rutile is very concerned about Mica's model rockets causing fires in the Village.
Mica and Slate's unsanctioned test of a powerful model rocket caused the Radio Tower's fire damage, leading to its closure (when Echoes of the Eye is not installed).
Hornfels' notice apologizes for the Radio Tower closure to everyone except Slate and Mica.
mechanics: Mica challenges the player to land the model ship on one of the Village geyser pools as a flight-control tutorial.
Mica's model ship controls identically to the real ship but poses no risk if crashed.
After a successful landing, Mica comments that this must be why Slate lets the protagonist fly the real ship.
After a crash, Mica nervously compares the result to the time the external fuel tanks exploded on reentry.
